formalEvidence.formalScope: Synthetic rule-boundary tests against the frozen public contract. No complete ordinary route, private author witness, browser execution, rendering performance, or physical-device testing is claimed.

numericalComparison.cumulativeDistanceMethod: Sum straight-line distance travelled on each accepted uninterrupted segment, compared with the actual accumulated per-step distances.

independentReview.method: Accepted commands define uninterrupted absolute flight segments. Position and travelled distance are evaluated directly from segment origin and age; observed coordinates do not reset predictions. Home/away spans integrate integer stamina with explicit saturation. Per-field residence windows intersect flower intervals and prerequisite completion dates; integer prefix counts and binary search find completion, with stable B1/B2 allocation of the last demand. Each observed frame is checked against these functions, not a replay of a per-tick movement/work controller.
limitations: Only the six existing actual public rounds are audited. No new gameplay, Model/pilot import, private plan, author checker or witness is used.
Receipt-prefix restoration recovers archived observations; it does not fill missing physical ticks. All stored physical frames and intervals are checked.

Accepted/rejected commands, actual input samples, dominant-axis selection, local priority and receipt links are checked; full rearming/navigation-repeat/cancellation state machines are not independently replayed.

API invalid dt, pause/retry and post-terminal freeze beyond these ordinary observations are outside this audit. Per-case counts identify encountered zero-endurance arrivals, final-demand contention and flower-boundary cases; absent cases are not claimed covered.

The public 1e-9 schedule-length normalization is part of the rule. The separate 1e-8 derived-value comparison does not widen arrival, stamina, flower, dependency or terminal gates. No additional fixtures are run.

candidateNormalPlay.scope: Trace contains only actual public observations. Missing intervals or operation observations are not fabricated; all seven permanent command/blocked/navigation/arrival/completion/unlock/rest-complete receipt arrays remain available. The separate six-case corpus retains every actual interval. Public menu planning is disclosed separately and does not execute or freeze physical time.
candidateNormalPlay.rootScope: Root reviewed all twelve actual candidate PNGs at1280 and960. Live screenshots are bounded by actual before/after snapshots, not asserted to equal a single endpoint. Browser preview only; no physical TV/phone test.
qaObservations: The three actual menus show 4/5/6 fields, 66/76/86 seconds and two six-bee groups with initial 30.0-second stamina.
The flight image shows B2 physically en route to F2 while B1 works F1; the sole earlier actual retarget receipt remains independently recorded.
The pollination image shows real F1 work 14/420 with B1 working, B2 at home, and F2 still marked SOON / UNLOCK before its opening.
The returned-home recovery image shows B1 RECOVERING at the hive with prior real home arrival and positive recovery credit; B2 is still working F2. This is not the initial full-stamina home state.
The cooperation image shows B1 and B2 both working F3, with actual credited work and 12 bees preserved.

Natural terminal state has all four fields complete, both groups at home, 2040 credited work ticks and score 1056. Both viewports retain complete controls, sidebar, footer version and frosted dialogs.
The small paused image follows a real short A-flight/R-reset prefix, not another completed positive round.

gameRules.scope: Bind actual swarm ownership, work/stamina accounts, permanent receipts and saved observation references. Closed-form flight, endurance and work-window correctness belongs to the independent audit; no production Model, planner or missing-tick reconstruction runs here.

performance.note: Intervals between observer RAF callbacks on this browser; not render CPU time or device FPS. WebGL multi_draw counts API submissions, not its subdraws. Canvas paint commands are not GPU draw calls. OffscreenCanvas workers are not observed.

ordinaryPollinatorManagement.scope: Actual key edges, sampled swarm ownership and seven permanent receipt histories. Work/recovery observations use positive actual interval credits while playing, excluding frozen settlement samples. An active retarget-flight observation requires the current flight ID to match that actual retarget command; a past retarget receipt alone is not such an observation. Sparse gaps and unobserved last-operation updates remain explicit. No flight integration, flower scheduling or missing-tick replay is run. Menu pilot preparations are excluded from gameplay evidence.

actualDispatchBarrier.scope: Actual post-dispatch snapshots and the next decision tick, or an observed later terminal tick. Recipe/menu observations remain separate.

encodedObservationAnchors.scope: Nine unmodified encoded images selected only from actual periodic public observations: three menus, actual swarm flight after a permanent retarget receipt, credited pollination, returned-home positive recovery, same-field cooperative credits, completed fields while a swarm is still flying home, and terminal hold. The flight image does not claim to depict the same particular retarget segment. No post-dispatch edge selection or extra Model run. Every image semantic still awaits personal review; receipt timing is not an exact pixel-state alias.

actualGameplay.artifactVerificationScope: Reuse the completed fetch verification of signature, alignment, CRC, manifest identity and signed assets; compare those exact signed asset hashes with the actual candidate build. No second signature or full ZIP verification run.

hardware.note: Software Chromium with ordinary input. Synthetic fixtures are labelled separately; export FPS is not device FPS.
